📖 How to use

      
  1. Enter the hour (1–12) and minute.
  2. Press Calculate.
  3. Read both angles and see the hands drawn on the dial.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Why does the hour hand move 0.5° per minute?
It sweeps 30° per hour, so each minute carries it 30/60 = 0.5° toward the next hour.
Which angle is reported?
The smaller of the two angles between the hands; the reflex (larger) one is shown too.
When do the hands overlap?
About every 65 minutes — e.g. near 1:05, 2:10, … solving 30h = 5.5m.
